title: Flutter & Dart Mobile Architecture

nodes.title: Dart Language Core & Type System
nodes.subtitle: Sound null safety, extension methods, records & patterns, mixins, factory constructors
learning_objectives: Leverage Dart sound null safety to prevent runtime null dereference exceptions
Use records, pattern matching, and mixins for clean data modeling
feynman_prompts: Explain how Dart sound null safety guarantees that non-nullable variables never contain null.
key_misconceptions: Overusing the ! operator instead of handling nullable states with if-case patterns

nodes.title: Dart Asynchronous Programming & Streams
nodes.subtitle: Futures, async/await, Streams, StreamControllers, generators (sync*, async*)
learning_objectives: Manage asynchronous operations cleanly with Futures and Streams
Create reactive data pipelines using StreamTransformers and broadcast streams
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental architectural difference between a Future and a Stream in Dart?
key_misconceptions: Using single-subscription streams when multiple UI listeners are required

nodes.title: Flutter Architectural Mechanics: The Three Trees
nodes.subtitle: Widget Tree, Element Tree, RenderObject Tree, layout & paint phases
learning_objectives: Explain the distinct responsibilities of the Widget, Element, and RenderObject trees
Diagnose and resolve common layout constraints (BoxConstraints) errors
feynman_prompts: Why does Flutter rebuild lightweight Widgets frequently while reusing persistent RenderObjects?
key_misconceptions: Assuming Widget rebuilds are expensive, confusing them with heavy DOM reflows

nodes.title: Responsive Layouts & Constraint Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Constraints go down, sizes go up, parent sets position; LayoutBuilder, MediaQuery
learning_objectives: Build responsive layouts adapting seamlessly to mobile, tablet, and desktop screens
Debug RenderFlex overflow errors using Flexible, Expanded, and SingleChildScrollView
feynman_prompts: Explain Flutter's golden layout rule: Constraints go down, sizes go up, parent sets position.
key_misconceptions: Wrapping unbounded widgets inside unbounded parents, triggering layout crashes

nodes.title: Reactive State Management with Riverpod 2.x
nodes.subtitle: NotifierProvider, AsyncNotifier, ref.watch vs ref.read, family, autoDispose
learning_objectives: Manage global reactive application state cleanly using Riverpod Notifiers
Handle asynchronous loading, error, and data states declaratively with AsyncValue
feynman_prompts: Why should ref.watch be used inside build() methods while ref.read is reserved for event callbacks?
key_misconceptions: Calling ref.read inside build() methods, causing UI to miss state updates

nodes.title: Declarative Navigation & Deep Linking with GoRouter
nodes.subtitle: GoRoute, ShellRoute, redirect guards, path parameters, nested tab navigation
learning_objectives: Configure type-safe declarative routing with nested bottom navigation ShellRoutes
Implement authentication redirect guards to protect private screens
feynman_prompts: How does declarative routing with GoRouter simplify deep linking and web URL synchronization?
key_misconceptions: Navigating imperatively with Navigator.push() without URL state synchronization

nodes.title: Networking with Dio & REST Architecture
nodes.subtitle: Dio client, interceptors, auth token refresh, retry policies, JSON serialization
learning_objectives: Implement robust API communication with centralized auth interceptors
Handle automatic JWT token refresh on HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses
feynman_prompts: How do Dio interceptors enable centralized auth injection and automatic retry policies?
key_misconceptions: Parsing raw JSON maps directly in UI widgets without strongly-typed data models

nodes.title: Offline Persistence: SQLite, Drift & Hive
nodes.subtitle: Local database design, Drift type-safe SQL, Hive / SharedPreferences caching
learning_objectives: Persist structured data offline using type-safe SQLite abstractions with Drift
Cache user settings and authentication tokens with SharedPreferences/Hive
feynman_prompts: Why should relational data with queries be stored in SQLite rather than flat key-value files?
key_misconceptions: Storing large structured datasets in SharedPreferences, causing UI freezes on startup

nodes.title: Custom Painting, Canvas & Path Animations
nodes.subtitle: CustomPainter, Canvas API, Path operations, Paint objects, CustomPaint widget
learning_objectives: Draw custom geometric shapes, graphs, and winding roadmap paths using Canvas
Optimize repainting by implementing shouldRepaint accurately
feynman_prompts: Why is returning false from shouldRepaint essential when CustomPainter properties haven't changed?
key_misconceptions: Allocating heavy Paint or Path objects inside the paint() method on every frame

nodes.title: Flutter Animations: Implicit vs Explicit
nodes.subtitle: AnimatedContainer, AnimationController, CurvedAnimation, Hero transitions
learning_objectives: Create fluid UI micro-interactions using implicit animated widgets
Build orchestrated multi-stage animations with AnimationControllers and TickerProvider
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between an implicit animation widget and an explicit AnimationController?
key_misconceptions: Forgetting to dispose AnimationControllers in State.dispose(), leaking memory

nodes.title: Clean Architecture & Feature-First Project Structure
nodes.subtitle: Domain (Entities, Use Cases), Data (Repositories, Data Sources), Presentation layers
learning_objectives: Organize scalable Flutter applications using feature-first domain-driven design
Decouple domain business logic completely from Flutter UI widgets and external packages
feynman_prompts: Why should domain entities and repository interfaces have zero dependencies on Flutter UI packages?
key_misconceptions: Calling API HTTP clients directly from widget build methods

nodes.title: Automated Testing: Unit, Widget & Integration
nodes.subtitle: flutter_test, testWidgets, WidgetTester, Finder, Mockito / Mocktail, Golden tests
learning_objectives: Write comprehensive unit tests for Riverpod notifiers and domain use cases
Test widget interactions and verify visual regression using golden tests
feynman_prompts: How does testWidgets simulate user taps, gestures, and frame pump ticks?
key_misconceptions: Running widget tests that perform real HTTP calls without mocking the network layer

nodes.title: Platform Channels: Native Android & iOS Integration
nodes.subtitle: MethodChannel, EventChannel, native Kotlin and Swift code integration
learning_objectives: Communicate bidirectionally between Dart and native Android (Kotlin) / iOS (Swift) code
Stream continuous native sensor or battery data to Flutter using EventChannels
feynman_prompts: Explain how the binary messenger serializes data across the platform channel boundary.
key_misconceptions: Passing massive binary payloads across MethodChannels synchronously, blocking the main UI thread

nodes.title: Performance Profiling & Memory Leak Optimization
nodes.subtitle: Flutter DevTools, CPU Profiler, Memory Allocations, RepaintBoundary, DevTools timeline
learning_objectives: Profile and fix UI jank and dropped frames (120fps optimization) using Flutter DevTools
Isolate expensive custom drawings using RepaintBoundary widgets
feynman_prompts: How does RepaintBoundary prevent expensive subtree repainting during animations?
key_misconceptions: Rebuilding the entire screen when only a single text label needs updating

nodes.title: Push Notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
nodes.subtitle: FCM tokens, background message handlers, local notifications, payload navigation
learning_objectives: Configure Firebase Cloud Messaging for foreground and background push alerts
Handle user notification taps and deep-link directly into relevant feature screens
feynman_prompts: Why must background message handlers be top-level or static entry points (@pragma('vm:entry-point'))?
key_misconceptions: Accessing Flutter UI context inside background notification handlers

nodes.title: Mobile Security: Biometrics & Secure Storage
nodes.subtitle: flutter_secure_storage, Keychain / Keystore encryption, local_auth biometrics
learning_objectives: Encrypt and store sensitive auth tokens using hardware-backed platform keystores
Enforce biometric Face ID / Fingerprint verification for sensitive app actions
feynman_prompts: Why is flutter_secure_storage safer for access tokens than standard SharedPreferences?
key_misconceptions: Storing plain unencrypted API secrets or tokens in local SQLite databases

nodes.title: CI/CD & Mobile Automation with Fastlane
nodes.subtitle: Fastlane match, App Store Connect API, Google Play publishing, GitHub Actions workflows
learning_objectives: Automate building and signing iOS IPAs and Android AABs with Fastlane
Publish automated TestFlight and Play Store internal track releases on PR merges
feynman_prompts: Why is automated mobile build signing via CI essential for engineering team velocity?
key_misconceptions: Manually building and uploading APKs/IPAs from personal developer machines

nodes.title: App Store & Play Store Launch Readiness
nodes.subtitle: App icons, splash screens, permissions rationale, store review guidelines, analytics
learning_objectives: Configure production app bundle identifiers, splash screens, and adaptive icons
Comply with Apple App Store and Google Play privacy nutrition and permission guidelines
feynman_prompts: What are the most common rejection reasons during App Store review and how do you avoid them?
key_misconceptions: Requesting sensitive runtime permissions without user context or explanatory UI

description: Master Flutter & Dart Mobile Architecture with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
